```{r}
library(fpp2)
library(TTR)

# Create Data Frame
df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/WomenEmploymentData.csv")
names(df)[2] <- "Number of Women Employed"

# Monthly data starting January 1955
emp <- ts(df[, 2], start = c(1955, 1), frequency = 12)

# We need to fill in the missing October 2025 Value
sum(is.na(emp))
emp <- na.interp(emp)

# Plot the data
plot(emp)

# STL decomposition
stl_decomp <- stl(emp, s.window = "periodic")
plot(stl_decomp)

# Seasonally adjusted line on the original
plot(emp)
lines(seasadj(stl_decomp), col = "Red")

# Default period forecast
f_stl <- forecast(stl_decomp)
f_stl <- forecast(stl_decomp,h=15)
f_stl
plot(f_stl)

# Other method
decomp_elec <- decompose(emp)

# Different Attributes
attributes(decomp_elec)
seasadj(decomp_elec)

```
